name: Cat Jam
short: The stealth label of Reflection's Beam 1.0 (501B/23B-active, Apache 2.0), live free on Zen 2026-10-12 to 10-16 before being renamed Beam Free: SWE-bench Verified 81.6%.
pricingNote: Free ($0/$0/$0) during the Oct 2026 stealth window; retired 2026-10-16 in favour of the opencode/beam-free id
freeTierNote: Free on OpenCode Zen and OpenCode Go for a limited time; the provider did not train on your data but retained it for 30 days for safety (not zero-retention)
pricingTiers: Free $0/$0/$0 on Zen (cat-jam-free, 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16, then deprecated)
Successor id: opencode/beam-free - the same Reflection Beam 1.0 weights, still free
standout: The same open weights as Beam 1.0 - one of the strongest open coding models, briefly served under a stealth name.
tradeoff: A three-day window and a 30-day-retention free route; use beam-free instead.
idNote: The id was deprecated on 2026-10-16 and replaced by opencode/beam-free for the same weights; the model is tracked separately in model/beam/.
